title: skill line ratchet: the tree-against-map check reads references/lanes/ only, so files under pm-dispatch references/domains/ are not held (plus stale lanes/ fixtures)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2uhJ1AYNPw5TUSVS

Filing gate: ① owed follow-up of PR #37495 (#35235, pm-dispatch step 4c). Source: fleet. Contract review 7188024721 nits N1–N3; seat ACCEPT 7188049056 ordered one card under #35235.
Blocked-by: #37495

After #37495 the five retired domain files (devx, server, skills, spec, ui) live in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/domains/`.

- [ ] N1 — `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the tree-against-map check (`LANES_DIR` / `laneFilesOnDisk`) reads `references/lanes/` only. A new or deleted file under `references/domains/` is no longer red by construction (the five keep their CEILINGS rows, but nothing compares the folder against the map). Extend the check to `references/domains/` with a red control.
- [ ] N2 — fixtures still naming `lanes/` paths for the moved files: the REF_B fixture in `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (~L6050; a guard instrument, so this edit makes its PR Tier H by path) and the `session-start-fleet` hook self-test fixtures.
- [ ] N3 — `.claude/hooks/session-start-fleet.sh`: the comment describing `lanes/$OS_FLEET_LANE.md` for the five retired lane names (they now read "no file on this checkout").

Suggested-grade: p3 · area:fleet · Task · tooling (a ratchet blind spot, nothing red today).
Dedupe: `laneFilesOnDisk domains`, `skill line ratchet domains` → no open card.

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectstack#35235.
